# Dwarves
Dwarves are a species of short, beared humanoids with a great love for alcohol
## Racial Features - Their blood has a dark red color. - They [color=#1e90ff]handle alcohol better[/color], requiring more to get drunk. - They are [color=#1e90ff]slightly healed by alcohol[/color]. - They are able to take [color=#1e90ff]110 damage before falling into a critical state, dying once they reach 220 damage[/color]. - Their fists deal [color=red]5[/color] blunt damage with unarmed attacks. - Their standard body heat is 37 degrees Celcius and they can withstand temperatures between -15 and 50 degrees Celcius.
## Grumbakul The Dwarf language, known as Grumbakul, is composed of gutteral grunts not too dissimilar to the humans's own language. It is described as simple and effective, easy to learn and even easier to speak.
## Age and Names A Dwarf's lifespan is almost identical to that of a human, reaching adulthood at 18 years of age and living until 150. Dwarven names are also almost the same as the ones used by humans.
